integrity: Analytical all-degree proof via exact Taylor disk norm and coefficient compactness; low-degree exact arithmetic checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The small-radius asymptotics fix polynomial degree first and are not uniform in degree.
Only equal-radius antipodal Euclidean disk pairs are covered.
Some classical small-island literature may provide implicit equivalent cases; independent priority verification outstanding.
title: Fixed-degree parity in capacity bounds for two vanishing disks
